run_stereo_rgb_agent: run a habitat-sim stereo RGB agent that spins in a circle and displays left-right camera pairs
run_stereo_depth_agent: run a habitat-sim stereo depth agent that renders normalized depth image pairs from left and right sensors
create_camera_sensor_spec: create a CameraSensorSpec with a uuid, resolution, and position offset for a stereo agent
create_agent_configuration: create an AgentConfiguration with a list of left and right CameraSensorSpec sensor specifications
render_stereo_pair: render concatenated left and right sensor observations as a stereo pair with optional depth normalization
